items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 5 Jan (UK only). Journey through house and techno as the queen of the dance floor, Honey Dijon, puts her unmistakable stamp on some golden tracks. A Chicago-born, Grammy-winning DJ, producer, activist, and fashion icon, Dijon embodies the pure, unadulterated spirit of house music. You can expect to hear glittering reworks of tracks from Neneh Cherry, 702, Dua Lipa, Madonna, DJ Minx and lots more. A We Are Grape production for BBC 6 Music.
items.title: The Art Of Remixing: Honey Dijon

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 29 Dec (UK only). As 6 Music Goes Dark we celebrate two decades of Skream’s seminal debut album with a deep dive into the darkest, moodiest dubstep 2006 had to offer. Expect cuts from the album alongside classic tracks from the likes of Mala, Kode9, Digital Mystikz, Coki and lots more A We Are Grape production for BBC 6 Music.
items.title: 20 Years Of Skream!

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 22 Dec (UK only). Cruise through a selection of classic US house anthems. Essential house tracks from the likes of Marshall Jefferson, Aly-Us, Sandy Rivera and Barbara Tucker. A We Are Grape production for BBC 6 Music.
items.title: Gotta have House Music!

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 15 Dec (UK only). Slow down to bask in autumn’s cool glow with an ambient hour of down-tempo and melodic electronica. A playlist perfect for a brisk Autumn walk or a cosy couch day. Expect to hear sounds from the likes of Aphex Twin, HAAi, Autechre, Four Tet, Boards of Canada and many more. A We Are Grape production for BBC 6 Music.
items.title: Autumnal Electronica

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 8 Dec (UK only). Nice ‘N’ Ripe and Ice Cream Records are two seminal London-based labels that defined and pioneered the sound of UK garage in the 1990s. You can expect Ice Cream Records Classics like Double 99’s Ripgroove and Kele Le Roc’s My Love (So Good) to Nice ‘N’ Ripe deep cuts from 24HR Experience, Jeremy Sylvester and Mike Millrain. A We Are Grape production for BBC 6 Music.
items.title: Nice 'N' Ripe Vs. Ice Cream Records

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 1 Dec (UK only). Lyricism layered upon banging beats from the wordsmiths of the dance floor. Lose yourself in the place where poetry meets dance, with words from Benjamin Zephaniah, George The Poet, Kae Tempest and beats by Overmono, Fred Again, The Orb and many more. A We Are Grape production for BBC 6 Music.
items.title: Way With Words (Where Poetry Meets Dance)

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 24 Nov (UK only). Boogie down to the sounds of Italo disco, new wave and funk. A tour in Italy soundtracked by the likes of Vivien Vee, Ken Laszlo, Giorgio Moroder, Peter Micioni, Bandaid and lots more. A We Are Grape production for BBC 6 Music.
items.title: Italo Disco Dancing!

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 17 Nov (UK only). An hour of music celebrating all things Bristol and beyond, tracing the evolution of 'The Bristol Sound' - from its roots in sound system culture to global trip-hop and its lasting impact on drum & bass. Featuring music from pioneers of The Bristol Sound Smith & Mighty, Fresh Four, and The Wild Bunch; trip-hop icons Portishead and Massive Attack; and signature jazz-infused drum and bass from the likes of Krust and Roni Size. As well as tracks from beyond Bristol that trace their roots straight back to the scene, including cuts from Björk, DJ Shadow, and L…
items.title: The Bristol Sound and Its Influence
